skill.summary: Automates finding motivated property sellers with owner contacts, market data, AI scoring, and personalized outreach for faster real estate lead generation.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Real Estate Lead Machine.
- Automatically scrapes and analyzes fresh property listings from major portals like Zillow, Rightmove, and LeBonCoin.
- Detects motivated seller signals (e.g., price drops, days on market) and enriches each property with comps, contact details, and estimated market value.
- Ranks leads by motivation and opportunity score; outputs ready-to-use CSV/JSON files.
- Generates AI-personalized outreach (email, SMS, follow-ups) for each lead.
- Supports flexible input options for location, property type, price range, and buyer profile.
